text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali and Mauritanian President Maaouya Ould Sid'Ahmed Taya held talks on Arab Maghreb Union issues.
- Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak asked Tunisian President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali to visit Egypt in a letter handed over by Egyptian Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri.
- Egyptian Prime Minister Ganzouri stressed the importance of boosting economic exchanges between Tunisia and Egypt in a meeting with Tunisian businessmen.
- President Ben Ali on Saturday held phone talks with Libyan leader Colonel Muammar Gaddafi on speeding up Arab Maghreb Union action.
